balls.text: nails the yorker on off stump, Botha squeezes it out to deep cover and comes back for a second run, hoping the throw will be bad. It isn't
overpitched outside off, slashed away through the covers. He's played a mini-blinder here!

oh! First off, this is a top edge and it carries nearly all the way to the third man boundary. Second, it was a full toss. Third, Morkel was rushing back to try and catch it. Then the ball pitches on the outfield and just pings away. Picked up pace and surprises Morkel
picks up the slower ball and slices it between point and short third man. Good, common-sense batting
creamed over the covers! Camps deep in his crease, expecting the yorker. The use of the crease makes sure he has enough leverage
wanders across outside off and slogs a full toss to deep midwicket

winds up again, and is caught at long-off. Tahir waves his forefinger around to celebrate, but Yusuf's done his bit. Loves the spinners so he backed himself to clear the field with another slash over the off side. Holes out
gets down the track and turns a flighted delivery into a full toss. Single through cover
full and on leg stump, pushed to long-on
goes for a wild sweep, to a legspinner outside off. Preempting the googly perhaps. Ends up with a toe-ender to short third man
flighted and into the block hole on leg stump, whipped to the right of long-on
into the crowd again! But I thought this was a mis-hit! Well flighted outside off, he got it close to the bottom of the bat but his power sends the ball over long-off
goes for a wide yorker, possibly the seam up delivery, Yusuf slashes it through the covers
offers a full toss, with enough room for Yusuf to swing those burly arms through the line. Too much for deep midwicket to bother with.
googly, tossed up well outside off, Yusuf just saw the ball go above his eye line and went for a slog. The ball turning the wrong way means he can only get an inside edge
and then he shows his range, takes a tossed up delivery from well outside off to deep square leg with a sweep
leans forward and lifts a good length ball from off stump over cover. Good shot, all he did was extend his hands from the old Test-match defence
loops it up on leg stump, jams his bat down and sends it to short cover, who has to dive to his right and keep it to nothing
tossed up outside off, slashed away wide of long-off, where Tiwary rushes around and parries the ball back inside the field of play
b-e-a-utiful! Saw the quicker ball, saw it short and pulled off a lovely little late cut past short third man. Amazing presence of mind
slower through the air and outside off, defended through the covers

there she blows! Another vicious slog, but it's flat. It can be caught. And it is, but Angelo Mathews. Lovely take, Tahir celebrates, and well he should. Flighted it, but made sure it was a shade outside off so that Russell didn't have room and if he wanted to hit out, like he did, the field was set for it
no contact with the lap sweep, and the ball dribbles between the keeper's gloves

big dive from the deep square leg fielder, but Shreyas can't quite pul this in. Great effort to try and claim the catch, had to run to his left and then pull out the full length dive. One-handed attempt, but  the slog sweep would not be denied
tossed up wide outside off, sliced to point
goes back and works it away into the leg side, to retain strike and usher the time out
doesn't pick the googly and he's nearly bowled 'im! Set up for a cut, has to hurry to protect his stumps and the flick bounces off his boot and scurries away past the keeper
pushed to long-on
"catch," the keeper yells. But it doesn't happen. This was a bump ball. Nicely tossed up on off stump and Yusuf drills it back at the bowler
drags it short, and its the leggie this time so it turns away and affords him so much room. Pasted over long-off. Just camped back and carved it
tossed up outside off, Yusuf goes for a full-blooded thump over cover. Has to settle for an inside edge through fine leg. Perhaps a googly fooling him?
slower ball from outside off swung away down to long-on

skews away to long-on and Saurabh's taken a good, running catch. The pinch hitter mistimes a back of a length delivery cramping him for room. Chawla has been making room every other ball, this time was no different, but Morkel hiked his pace up and bowled an awkward line on leg and even outside it. Can't swing the arms freely from there
cuts back in at Yusuf, who is up for it as he moves across and whips the ball with an exaggerated roll of the wrists to deep square leg
full on leg stump, Yusuf just helps it on its destined path to the long leg boundary
shortish on leg stump, picked up over square leg. Not all that convincingly, mind
clears the front leg in light of a slower and fuller delivery. But the offcutter beats his big swing, and only just misses off stump. Lovely bowling
goes on the bounce to long-on. Chawla continues rush down at Yuvi, and Yuvi continues to adjust his length accordingly
cut away, but Daredevils have protection in the deep
tapped to long-off as he stays beside the flatter delivery outside off
pushed through down leg, and Yusuf lap-pulls to fine leg
what was wrong with that, asks Yuvi! Good length ball, with only a hint of room, Yusuf goes for a big heave over the covers. The bat face turns on impact, and yet it soars away
saw the batsman rushing at him and only then does Yuvi fires it in. Nearly goes through him, but Chawla is able to bring down that big batswing and get an inside edge past the keeper
full and outside off, Chawla goes for a flick and connects only with his pads
overpitched and Chawla wades into it. Steps forward and belts this offcutter down the ground

huuuuge appeal, every Daredevils fielder is is in the face of the umpire Chaudhary, who confidently signals leg-bye. And he seems to be right. Yusuf goes for a pick up off his hips, but the ball just leaps off his legs to square leg
124 kph, can he be beaten for pace at that pace? Apparently he can. It was a shade shortish and outside off, goes for a cut and misses
fuller deliver on off stump, slid towards point off the open face again. It's the offcutter that jags back at him
back of a length on off stump, Yusuf uses soft hands to glide it to point. Wanted a single, not there
flighted outside off, pushed in front of point
hands him a short ball outside off, cut to deep point

slowed it up so nicely! Pandey was into the flick way too early, and then the ball finally floats over to him, dribbles off the inside edge and onto the stumps. Lovely delivery against a man looking to constantly play leg side. Make your own pace, says Yuvi, and comes off better for it
shortish on off stump, pulled to deep midwicket
getes down the track, but Yuvi's pulled his length back. Adjusts to slice it behind point
short and outside off, cracked to point
back of a length on leg stump, slid off the open face into the off side

loses his footing, but yet he's connected and then some! The look away, fall away pull to suare leg. Mathews completely beat him for pace, and he wouldn't give any room either. The ball was coming up towards his nose too, but his reflex reaction helps him out
full and wide outside off, Pandey smears it through the covers
shortish and outside off, goes for a cut and misses.
back of a length on leg stump, following Chawla's intention to back away, chops to point and seeks refuge at the other end
and there it is, flrst ball. Chawla keeps to his crease and slices it to point
lots off flight on off stump, and he sizes it up nicely to whip wide of long-on
tossed up outside off, thumped down to long-off
pinch hitter doing what he is supposed to. Hit out or get out. Nearly carried as far as the deep cover fielder as he stayed leg side of the ball and scythed it over the top
short and slipping down leg, Chawla was looking to lap-pull through fine leg, misses
tossed up on off stump, lifted over cover
slips in the googly on off stump, Chawla only guesses it after it turns. Gets an outside edge to short third man. Where Mishra keeps him honest. Had wanted a quick single, but had to rush back
tossed up outside off, Pandey waits as much as he can and slices it to point

struck in front! This was pushed through on leg stump, pulling Uthappa into a sweep, but the ball gains a lot of turn from the pitch and hits him in front of middle stump. Seemed a fair decision. Lovely bowling, went wide of the crease to create a different angle
shortish and outside off, he adds to the room on offer by moving leg side, and cuts to point
moves away from the line of the good length ball on middle and chops it to cover
leaps away from leg stump as he cuts a short, flat delivery to point
another googly, this time it's shorter in length and it's cut past point
gives the googly a lot of air, Pandey was hoping for a cut but is beaten as the ball turns in. Adjusts well enough though as he softens his hands and dabs it away
flighted outside off, Pandey turns it around to long-on as well
picks the googly, and it's flat as well, whipped to long-on
looped up outside off, Uthappa gets down on one knee and lap-sweeps it fine. Knight Riders have been quite proactive against the spinners. Good ploy
the googly is his safe place, tosses it up on leg stump and has the batsman a bit uncertain. Defends, gets a little glove, but it pops up too far in front of the keeper on the leg side
presents a long hop which is gleefully pulled over midwicket. Dreadful way to start, but perhaps this stuck in his hand
tossed up on off stump, gets Uthappa forward to block
keeps back against a fuller, flatter googly, this was. Just about defends it
stays back to a slightly flatter delivery outside off, punched into the off side
flighted outside off, but it gets the closed face of the bat as Pandey reaches forward and smothers it. Single to long-on
a shade shortish and he cuts to point
flighted outside off, leans into a drive to cover

punishment, and every one of these hits will hurt Morkel. He had set up a lovely plan and executed it perfectly the two balls ago. This time though he offers up a fuller length and the straight bat of Uthappa answers with authority. Time out, now
shortish and outside off, cracked to point

dropped. And this was a dolly too. Yuvi's let one spill through his hands at short midwicket after Uthappa goes for a front-foot flick. Not quire full enough for that stroke and the ball just popped up. Should have been taken
stays back to clip a shortish ball off the pads and through midwicket
huge, not to mention awful appeal, from Morkel. Huge inside edge onto pad as this good length ball cuts back in quite sharply. Was it that it hit a crack?
served up full and belted down the ground. Forceful stroke, as he cleared his front leg a touch and allowed his hands to go through the line of the ball
gets that front foot across outside off to use Zaheer's angle from around the stumps to his advantage. But the back of a length delivery can only be tucked as far as midwicket
fuller delivery on off stump, pushed back at the bowler
fullish on off stump, from around the wicket, tapped gently towards mid-on
that's an important strike and it's a carbon copy of many Gambhir dismissals. Lured into the drive, some away swing foils the stroke, and the outside edge is pouched by the keeper
shortish and outside off, Gambhir slaps it to point
shortish and outside off, nudged through midwicket
punched down the ground to long-on

so that's how you respond to being beaten by a part-timer. Dances down the pitch, didn't quite reach the ball, but goes through with the shot. Full swing of the arms has the ball soaring to long-on, where Manoj Tiwary was setting himself up on the edge and then drops it. Did everything right, but it just spilled out
cuts back in off the deck quite sharply! And this is JP Duminy. Uthappa was looking to defend and he's beaten by the turn
good length ball on leg stump, Gambhir allows it to turn and dabs it behind square leg
through the covers again, this time along the ground. Half-volley presented in kind, Gambhir accepts gleefully
clear message of intent. It tossed up from around the wicket, Gambhir stayed inside the line of it and lofted it over extra cover. Calculated strike
moves around the wicket to try and contain the room he gives outside off. Also to perhaps enhance the threat of his off cutter. This is back of a length and at his full pace, defended
phew, first signs of the pitch's alliances. An off cutter from the paceman grips into the deck and rears past the prodding bat. Exaggerated movement
another outside edge that races away to the third man boundary! It's full, draws him to slash. Nick results and it's lucky for the batsman
offers a full and wide delivery that Uthappa slashes to cover on the edge of the circle. Could have done better
and predictably, the next ball is on the pads and it's been crunched to the square leg boundary. Keeping it shortish is a good idea against him, but it needs to rise well above the hips
cracks a back of a length delivery towards extra cover. The throw is wayward again, possibly why Gambhir didn't bother to ground his bat
good length ball outside off, drilled to mid-off

healthy outside edge, but it flies away well wide of the lone slip fielder. They've been bowling for that mode of dismissal, keeping the ball drivable and outside off. Uthappa was sucked into the trap, but escapes on a technicality. No second slip
full and slid down the leg side, Uthappa goes for a flick and misses
back of a length and outside off, Gambhir dabs it past gully
full and outside off, Uthappa leans forward to punch to mid-off. Wants the single this time and makes his ground despite a direct hit from the same man, Duminy

good work from Mathews, but all of that is messed up by the man from mid-off! A Gambhir run out for the taking and the throw doesn't hit. Duminy had ample time, even to run in and underarm a throw. Didn't help that Morkel didn't care about backing up. In the end, a sublime cover drive has been stopped by a lovely diving effort from Mathews. Gambhir had raced halfway down and is very lucky to survive
shortish on off stump, Uthappa rides the bounce and secures a single to third man
that's much better, takes care to keep bat and pad together as he nudges into the covers and sets off
beats him on the push again. Healthy away swing this time as he pitches it on a good length just outside off and jerks it away off the pitch
oh, that's stuck in his hands a bit too long. Searching for the awayswinger again, but it wanders away miles outside the off stump
curls the fuller delivery away and exploits Gambhir's nervousness outside off. Nearly takes the outside edge. Barely any footwork
clipped off his toes very neatly as Zaheer pendulums from off to leg. Easy two to long leg
teasing outside off, Uthappa was lured into playing and tucked his bat behind his pads quite late
a hint of shape in at the batsman, but it had begun on leg and slipped further down
full toss outside off, slashed over short third man for a boundary to sign off.
hits the yorker on leg stump, Morkel gets his boot out of the way and blocks. that's all he can do with a ball like that
short ball, pulled powerfully towards long-on. Pandey is the man who rushes across and then fluffs it, and it goes for four as well
fired in full and at his legs, Morkel skews it to long-off
length and outside off, goes away for a one-bounce four to the right of long-off. Made room again and he got the length he wanted, allowed him to get under the ball
saw the batsman making room outside off and Umesh spears in the yorker a bit too far outside off
hits the yorker on middle and off, chopped into the covers

that's the last time the pull shot will fail him tonight. It's his normal pace, and it's short without offering too much room. Mathews swivels on the back foot for the stroke, but he's still a bit late on the shot. Inside edge crashes into timber
length ball, smashed over the bowler's head. Mathews finally gets one in his range, and it's the normal pace as well. Struck cleanly
back of a length on middle, slogged out to deep midwicket
140-plus kph banged in quick and short, Saurabh is eons late on the pull.
hits the wide yorker, sliced to point. Only a single
back of a length slower ball defeats the Mathews pull again and Uthappa runs down to have a word with the bowler.
full on off stump, dug out to long-on
good length ball, slower as well, fools Mathews who is thinking of slogs. Misses as it sneaks under the bat
gets down the track to a good length ball and crunches it through the non-striker's legs this time
fuller and slower outside off, Saurabh was moving outside leg and despite that was able to reach out and connect well enough to find a boundary through the covers
full on off stump, hammered back down the ground and has the umpire doing the splits. Didn't need to because the middle stump had got in the way
shortish and outside off, Saurabh swings and is too late on the shot. Bunts it by his own feet and Umesh rushes up to keep it to nothing
starts with an offcutter that slips down the leg side. Saurabh's flick can't connect
pushed through on off stump, flicked through to deep midwicket
another short ball, Saurabh sends it into orbit over deep midwicket. Loads of hang time on that as it sails into the crowd
drags it short and Mathews nails a pull to deep midwicket
launched over long-on! Uses the room on offer to belt this tossed up delivery over the bowler's head. Need a few of those with the asking-rate soaring
flighted on middle, turned away to long leg for a good, hard-run couple
gets down the track and slugs the good length ball to long-on
tucked away through midwicket
nearly carries to short cover! That's the googly, but Saurabh hasn't picked it. Goes for a flick, and the leading edge lands one bounce short of Yusuf
flighted on off stump, turned to deep midwicket

did not look promising at all as he connected with the slog sweep. Finds the man in the deep. it was a good plan, going with the spin and heaving it away towards the shorter part of the ground. But he hasn't timed it well at all. Seemed to have got under it too much
113kph, that's the quicker one, possibly seam up, Mathews whips it behind square leg
that's a terrific strike! Picked up the legbreak on off stump and reverse swatted it over point. Loads of power in the stroke
stood firm on middle and leg and belted the length ball down the ground. He's played Narine really well this innings. Stays very low in his stance and gains all his leverage from there
ripper! This was the carrom ball pushed fuller, so he had Mathews coming forward with a tentative poke. Beats the outside edge and wanders off his thighs
shortish and outside off, Mathews opens the face towards point to try and scamper a single. Not there
flighted on middle, JP goes for the slog sweep but can't beat the fielder in the deep
pushed through quite a way outside off. JP is happy to collect the extra
turns the other way and Mathews only reads it off the deck, tapped to long-on
goes back and flicks a flatter delivery through midwicket again
stays back to punch a shortish delivery along the ground to deep midwicket

down the track and lifts the ball down Russell's throat at deep midwicket. Didn't quite reach the pitch, but hoped his power would help make up the difference. Doesn't as the fielder races in a long way from the boundary and takes it so cleanly. Top catch
good length delivery on off stump, Yuvi just about keeps it out
flighted on middle, defended
down to long-off. Picked him out. Filghted outside off and Jadhav goes for a big hit, all he cared about was the six. Lost his shape, shaves the outside half of the bat, and he's easily held by Botha
tossed up on off stump, JP keeps that front leg aside and drives to long-on. Wanted more than the single there, considering he hit the ball in the air
whipped from off stump through to deep square leg as he adjusts to the ball turning into him. That's the time out as well
turns away from Duminy, who keeps back and cuts to point
flighted on middle, Jadhav goes low for a sweep and hits it along the ground to long leg. That seemed more a straighter ball than anything
another shortish delivery outside off, steered through point
that's short and JP's made it look worse by leaping back in the crease, staying quite low and pulls viciously over midwicket. Only one place it was headed
spins in at the batsman, who goes back and pulls to deep midwicket
goes for a cut with just a hint of room, but it stays low gets the bottom edge and scurries through Uthappa's legs again
flighted on middle from around the wicket, Jadhav sweeps powerfully to long leg
this has turned the other way, but Jadhav has picked it up and hammered it over long-on. Spectacular timing. Should flight the ball a bit more
skewed off the outside half of the bat as he charges down for a big heave down the ground.
well flighted outside off and Jadhav slams it over cover. There is protection in the deep though
shortish and outside off, eased through the covers off the back foot
plays on! And Hoggy's off on a run! It's a flat, quick, turning delivery. Shreyas was moving back and making room to cut. But the turn foils his efforts. Ends up chopping onto off stump
bottom edge sneaks through Uthappa's gloves and his splayed feet. Can't call that a catch. But Shreyas was certainly beaten on the googly
flat and quick on middle and leg, forced into the leg side and Hoggy rushes to his right, dives and sends the Eden crowd roaring
flighted outside off, JP gets on one-knee for a slog sweep, but he mistimes it. Ends up wide of long-on
tries to make room, but Hoggy's spin cramps him up. Whipped to deep midwicket
stays back in his crease, and low as well. Clips a good length ball from the ever-smiling Hogg to deep square leg
goes back to a shortish delivery and taps it to long-on
straight to long-on! Danced down the track, so he tossed the ball wider outside off. Manoj has to reach out for it and his timing suffers.
flighted outside off, Shreyas steps forward and clatters it to deep cover. Long-off was helping out as well, so Russell indulges in a relay throw
fired in quick and flat outside off, chopped to point
tossed up on middle and leg, Manoj goes down into a slog sweep and beats Manish Pandey on the boundary. Neatly picked up
flighted outside off, scythed to long-off
gets down the track to block a good length ball
goes for a reverse sweep, but gets no timing. Wide slip is on hand to keep it to nothing

dropped by Gambhir! That's the easiest catch of the day, and Hoggy just smiles. He's beaten the batsman with a ripper of a googly. Shreyas was making room for the cut, and ended up having to reach for the ball, Goes off the bottom of the bat and balloons to backward point, giving the KKR captain so much time. Goes reverse cup and shells it. Dreadful
charges at the bowler, first time he faces him, only gets an inside edge as Hoggy manages to make the ball dip on him. Single to deep square leg
whipped away through midwicket
tossed up outside off, drummed to cover
stays put on the crease, waits for the ball to spin and drives through the covers. If a little uppishly
down the track, has to adjust to the googly bowled flatter, nudged behind square leg
another shorter delivery outside off, cracked to the sweeper
pushed through, think he expected the wrong 'un, goes back and blocks
encore! Except he's hit this a little closer to ground. Gets beside the ball to use the legspin to his advantage. Again, spectacular balance and bat speed
that's a phenomenal strike from Shreyas! Over extra cover, pure timing! Pressed forward, got the the pitch and then his fast hands did the rest
goes for a big sweep, but the ball is on a length and well outside off so he only gets a toe-end to point
covers the stumps and flicks a good length ball through to deep square leg
shortish and outside off, chopped towards point
carrom ball, not at all picked, and Shreyas is lucking he has not moved his back leg. Rips past his outside edge as he was going for a flick
tossed up outside off, he jumps down the track to go for a big shot. Gets a leading edge as he closes the face too early. Nearly carries to deep cover
appeal from behind the wicket, but Narine doesn't bother. He knew the offspinner was going down. Seems to be a bit slower than before, Narine

targeting the body and Shreays is in the most awful position. Stuck in the crease, head tucking into his shoulders and the hands reaching up for the ball. Gloves the rapid short ball into the leg side
tries to get on top of a short delivery outside off, but he can only chop it into the covers
back of a length on off stump, pushed to mid-on
very short from Russell, Shreyas goes for a hook but he can't touch it. Too slow. Russell's loving the pace and bounce on it in the night
good length ball brings the batsman forward with a push into the covers
shortish and outside off, guided to point
and he's helped himself to another boundary, as a result of his footwork again. It's short and he camps back to pull to the midwicket boundary
gets down the track and to the pitch, reaches out with his hands and lifts the ball over extra cover. Good, confident stroke from Manoj
that was the offie, the one that was under contention! And the  batsman hasn't seen it. Sought to cut the delivery which was turning into him on leg stump.
pushed through on middle and leg, defended down the pitch. Was that the offie? Not quite. Slid straight on
lots of turn away, and the batsman reads it off the pitch, waits on it and dabs to point. Carrom, again
"catch it," is the call as the flighted delivery on middle is turned towards midwicket. Falls on the bounce. Carrom ball, that was
slower ball on off stump, tapped into the covers for a quick single
banged into the middle of the pitch, and it rears well over the batsman's head
full on off stump, ends up a low full toss, which is pushed to cover.
dances down, but Russell changes his length to a short one on middle. Manoj has to pull out of the stroke
shortish and outside off, waits on it and guides it behind point
spots the slower ball and simply flicks it over long-on. His timing's been spot on today. Keeps his shape, leans forward and lets his hands and his balance talk
back of a length and on off stump, tucked to midwicket

switches out to the fuller length this time, and Manoj is nowhere near prepared. Stuck on the back foot, crouching to adjust to the difference in length and flashes outside off. Looking very awkward out there
stays beside the shortish delivery outside off and dabs the 150kph delivery to point
hits him high on the pads as he is beaten for pace. This was back of a length on middle and leg, Manoj was going for a flick but he's ages too late. Only gets a leg bye towards third man
goes short and outside off, Manoj camps back for a pull to long-on. Mistimed, goes off the bottom of the bat. Shreyas seeks a single, but he is sent back
fuller delivery on middle and leg, nicely nudged to the right of mid-on. Concerted effort to keep the bat straight there from Shreyas
just short of a good length, punched into the covers off the open face. This was 147kph, says speed gun
goes short at over 140 kph, but striving for that pace, his direction goes awry. Wide down leg
that was awkward, jagged back in from back of a length, he somehow stabs it towards third man
slower one, offcutter, he gets forward and across, and mistimes the drive off a closed bat-face to the bowler
short, he sways inside the line and lets it go
that is so well timed it has beaten third man, who only had to move a few paces to his right, widish short of a length ball, he cuts it in a flash and Chawla's dive in the deep is futile
comes in from back of a length, he punches off the back foot, to square third man
short of a length, pushed down the track from the crease
goes full on middle now, and Tiwary gets something from the over, tucking it through the midwicket region
tries to force a shortish ball away but it comes on too quickly and he jabs it towards mid on
short of a good length, just outside off, he rides the bounce and taps it down into the pitch
shorter now, bouncing and swerving away at 140.6 kph, he has a look and lets it be
much fuller and closer to the stumps, Tiwary gets some bat down on it, and manages a thick inside edge to the leg side
pitched up, angled in slightly, and moving away outside off, left alone
